# AI-generated circuit-search candidates

**All new experimental work, code, verification scripts, mathematical commentary and submission text were generated by OpenAI Codex at the submitter's request. No independent human mathematical review is claimed.** Inherited code and mathematics retain their original authorship and notices.

This is an isolated research candidate for scrutiny. It does not update the repository's headline theorem or replace its existing verification targets. In particular, no new Lean certificate is supplied.

Two results are included:

| Route | Conditional saving `kappa` | Comparison |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Regrouping this repository's round-six side circuit | `36675644497175837593 / 10^24` | 0.027243% above this repository's pinned round-six value |
| Regrouping the generic first axis of the community PR39 construction | `3955279 / 10^11` | 1.765085% above the pinned community witness; 7.874220% above this repository's value |

The stronger result uses the **community construction and assembly**, not merely new parameters in this repository's unchanged construction. Both comparisons concern the saving in `O(n (log n)^(1-kappa))`, not measured running time or a claim of worldwide priority.

## What changed

In the community's generic 23-dimensional first-axis circuit, ordinary totals become left-associated sums. Leave-one-out sums are computed by a tree split at the largest power of two below the current length, propagating sums of disjoint sibling subtrees. The weighted pair recursion retains its size-two base case.

This increases additions from 34,764 to 36,328 but increases valid carrier matches from 1,324 to 4,044. The resulting role count drops from 38,776 to 37,620. The fixed 25-dimensional second axis is inherited unchanged. The exact bit network has `m=575`, `W=185523129`, and rank mass `106673952275`.

`search_community.py:mutated` contains the changed producer. `audit_community.py` reconstructs every scalar output, interprets the labels as explicit rational subspaces, checks every gate and matched inclusion, checks the event order, recomputes the transition histogram and reconstructs the complete child profile. `verify.py` bounds logarithms and exponentials with rational series and checks the moment inequalities. `community_assembly.py` is the attributed upstream assembly checker.

## Reproduce the finite checks

From the repository root:

```sh
python3 independent/ai-circuit-search/run_checks.py
# equivalent optional target:
make ai-circuit-check
```

Python 3.11+ and the standard library suffice; do not pass `-O`. The submitted run used Python 3.12.14. It checks source/input hashes, six exact root brackets, both candidate circuits, seven adversarial arithmetic tests, and three existing round-six tests. The new community candidate passes all 47 strict assembly constraints.

The two compressed files in `witnesses/` contain positive-label and matching witnesses. They are data, not executables. The Python audit reconstructs the graph and checks those witnesses; it does not need a C++ compiler. “Separate audit” means a separate implementation in the same AI session, not independent expert review.

## Regenerate the producer and search

For a fresh matching or the 45-case community search, compile the attributed C++17 helpers. From this directory, with a C++ compiler on PATH:

```sh
mkdir -p build
c++ -O2 -std=c++17 vendor/croc/scripts/partial_swap/match_exported_dag.cpp -o build/match_exported_dag.exe
c++ -O2 -std=c++17 vendor/croc/scripts/partial_swap/match_positive_dag.cpp -o build/match_positive_dag.exe
c++ -O2 -std=c++17 -Ivendor/croc/scripts/partial_swap match_positive_export.cpp -o build/match_positive_export.exe
python3 audit_community.py
python3 search_community.py
python3 build_certificate.py
python3 verify.py
```

The `.exe` suffix is only a portable filename convention in these scripts. On Windows, a Visual Studio developer prompt can build the same sources with `cl /O2 /EHsc /std:c++17`, `/I` for the third helper and `/Fe` for the output. Compiler assertions must stay enabled. `match_positive_export.cpp` only adds matching-witness export to the upstream matcher.

Earlier exploratory batches are `search.py`, `search_variants.py`, `experimental_search.py broad`, `experimental_search.py smallbase`, `experimental_search.py refine`, `search_reuse.py`, and `search_evolution.py`, in that order. The recorded 652 evaluations include overlaps and equivalent configurations; they are not 652 distinct algorithms. Their floating scores are discovery data, not proofs. Regeneration changes the submitted snapshot and consequently its integrity manifest.

## Review boundary

The main review question is whether the changed first-axis circuit transfers correctly through all inherited physical interfaces. The finite audit establishes exact sums, independent subspace bases, positivity, inclusions, acyclic carrier links and the stated counts. It does **not** independently re-prove the fixed25 CRT/profile certificate, simultaneous physical basis choice, copied-stream and arbitrary-scratch implementation, native tape routing, analytic precision, prime setup or exact recovery.

The full upstream multiplication theorem remains an assumption. Enormous constants and eventual thresholds remain. This is not a practical multiplier, a complete formal proof, or a request to accept a new unconditional theorem on the strength of tests.
